Faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Faq.subtitle: What WeeComi builds, how the products work, and how to choose the right one.

items.q: WHAT KIND OF PRODUCTS DO YOU BUILD?
items.a: WeeComi International builds independent digital products for commerce, AI, finance and business operations. The portfolio includes WeeNetwork, WeeKobi, WeeSale, Alışveriş Kapıda, WeeComi Bot, WeeCoins, WeeZard and CriptoSwaps.

items.q: ARE THE PRODUCTS CONNECTED TO EACH OTHER?
items.a: No. Products are not locked together. WeeMenu or WeeCard can be used on their own. What they share is WeeComi's development, security and support standard.

items.q: WHICH MARKETS DO YOU FOCUS ON?
items.a: We are based in Turkey. We offer Turkish, English, Azerbaijani, Russian and Georgian experiences for Azerbaijan, Georgia, Russia and Europe-focused markets.

items.q: HOW DO WE CHOOSE THE RIGHT PRODUCT?
items.a: We clarify your need together and recommend the independent product that fits. You can go to the product site, or contact the corporate team.
